scripts.install:all: bun install && bun install --cwd ./web && bun install --cwd ./playground && bun install --cwd ./sdk
scripts.db:init: bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx prisma generate
scripts.dev: bun run build:sdk && bun run dev:all
scripts.dev:all: bun run build:sdk:watch & bun run dev:api
scripts.build:app: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun && mkdir -p ./dist && cp -R ./src ./dist/src && cp ./src/workers/job-runner/worker.ts ./dist/worker.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:sdk && bun run build:app
scripts.docker:debug: docker build -t orca-api . && docker run --rm -p 3000:3000 --env-file .env orca-api
